Cody Gakpo: 2024-25 Season Stats, Goals & Impact Analysis

8 Aug, 2026
|

Cody Gakpo: The Rising Star Lighting Up Liverpool and the Netherlands

Cody Gakpo has emerged as one of the most exciting talents in European football, captivating fans and scouts alike with his versatility, creativity, and clutch performances on the pitch. Born on May 7, 1999, in Eindhoven, the Netherlands, this forward has carved out an impressive career trajectory that took him from the youth ranks of PSV Eindhoven to the bright lights of Anfield, where he now serves as a key figure for Liverpool FC and the Dutch national team.

Early Career and PSV Eindhoven Breakthrough

Gakpo’s footballing journey began in the academies of PSV Eindhoven, one of the Netherlands’ most prestigious clubs. His progression through the youth system was marked by consistent displays of technical ability and a mature understanding of the game that belied his age. By the time he broke into the first team during the 2018–2019 season, it was clear that PSV had a special player on their hands.

During his five seasons at PSV, Gakpo made over 120 appearances, scoring more than 50 goals and providing numerous assists. His ability to play across the front line — whether as a central striker, an inside forward, or a creative attacking midfielder — made him an invaluable asset. Under the guidance of coach Phillip Cocu and later Roger Schmidt, Gakpo refined his game into a formidable weapon that European giants could not ignore.

The Move to Liverpool

In January 2023, Liverpool FC completed the signing of Cody Gakpo for a fee reported to be around £37 million, a deal that represented one of the most significant captures of the winter transfer window. The move to Anfield marked a new chapter in his career, and Gakpo wasted no time in making an impact for his new club.

His debut season at Liverpool saw him adapt remarkably well to the demands of the Premier League. Jurgen Klopp, known for his ability to develop and maximize player potential, quickly recognized the unique qualities that Gakpo brings to the squad. The Dutch forward’s work rate, pressing intensity, and willingness to track back aligned perfectly with Liverpool’s high-pressing philosophy.

One of the defining moments of his Liverpool career came in the 2024–2025 season, where Gakpo established himself as one of the most consistent performers in the squad. His partnership with fellow forwards such as Mohamed Salah and Darwin Nunez added a new dimension to Liverpool’s attack, making them one of the most feared forward lines in world football.

International Success with the Netherlands

On the international stage, Cody Gakpo has been a crucial member of the Netherlands squad. He made his senior debut for the Oranje and has since become a regular contributor, featuring prominently in major tournaments including the FIFA World Cup 2022 in Qatar and UEFA Euro 2024.

His performances at the World Cup, in particular, showcased his ability to perform on the biggest stages. Gakpo’s goal-scoring instinct and link-up play were instrumental in the Netherlands’ campaigns, earning him widespread acclaim from pundits and fans across the footballing world.

Playing Style and Key Attributes

What sets Gakpo apart from many of his contemporaries is his remarkable versatility. He is comfortable playing in multiple positions across the attacking third, which makes him an incredibly valuable player for any team. Some of his key attributes include:

  • Technical ability: Gakpo possesses excellent close control, dribbling skills, and a well-tuned first touch that allows him to navigate tightly marked spaces with ease.
  • Finishing: Whether with his strong left foot or his right, he is a clinical finisher who can score from various angles and distances.
  • Creativity: Beyond his goals, Gakpo has a keen eye for key passes and through balls that can break open well-organized defenses.
  • Work ethic: His defensive contributions and pressing from the front are exceptional, reflecting the modern forward who is expected to contribute in all phases of play.
  • Big-game mentality: Gakpo has repeatedly proven that he rises to the occasion, delivering crucial goals and performances in high-pressure matches.

Impact on Liverpool’s Attack

Since his arrival at Liverpool, Cody Gakpo has transformed the club’s attacking dynamics. His ability to drop deep and collect the ball, combine with midfielders, and then either shoot or create for teammates has given Liverpool a tactical flexibility that opponents find difficult to deal with.

Under the management of Arne Slot, who succeeded Jurgen Klopp, Gakpo has continued to thrive. The new manager has utilized him in various roles, sometimes as a central forward and at other times drifting wide, exploiting his pace and agility against tired defenses.

The Future Outlook

As Cody Gakpo continues to develop and mature as a player, the outlook for his career is exceptionally bright. At just 25 years old, he has already achieved significant success at both club and international levels. His trajectory suggests that he has the potential to become one of the premier forwards in world football over the coming years.

Liverpool fans will be eager to see him reach new heights with the club, while the Netherlands national team will view him as a cornerstone of their attacking plans for the next World Cup cycle. With his combination of talent, dedication, and humility, there is every reason to believe that Gakpo’s best years are still ahead of him.

Conclusion

Cody Gakpo’s journey from the streets of Eindhoven to the global stage of Liverpool FC and the Netherlands national team is a testament to his hard work, talent, and determination. As one of the most exciting players in modern football, he continues to deliver moments of magic and consistency that make him indispensable to his teams. For fans and analysts alike, following the rise of this dynamic forward is one of the most compelling stories in contemporary football.
